'''Lusankya LS LSC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lusankya]]
* '''Published:''' 28 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 WHT Lusankya LS 2003 LSLSC.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My lightside deck in case anyone read my other post and was wondering

The published list has 63 cards.
